name: Floor Bounce / Empty Basement
setup: Price hits a major floor node (negative GEX) with zero significant nodes underneath — the 'Empty Basement.' SPY/QQQ at hard floors with no downside volume. Cross-reference Heatseeker node with chart structural levels for confluence.
entry: Limit buy as price taps the floor node. If you miss the initial touch, wait for the 'Retest Entry' — price pumps, then retests the level. Enter at the start of the strong candle following the retrace. Scale-in: 25-50% starter at ±5 points, full size on deeper dip.
exit: Trim 1: 30% immediately on first sharp reaction. Trim 2: another 50% after first pullback holds and new highs print. Hold runners if 61.8-79% Fibonacci retracement (Golden Zone) holds.
probability: High when 2-of-3 Trinity members show floor with empty basement below.
key_rules: Empty Basement Rule: no nodes below floor = hard floor, even if SPX shows lower magnets
2-of-3 Trinity Filter: if SPY+QQQ hold floors, SPX bearish magnet is overruled
Node Dissolve: after bounce, floor node should SHRINK — if it grows, bounce is fake (Bearish Divergence)
Clear Skies: no upside nodes after floor bounce = no resistance = 'Full Send' reversal
edge_cases: Divergence Acceptance: if strongest ticker (QQQ) holds floor, trade is valid even if SPY lags
Structural Confluence: Heatseeker floor + chart history level = higher conviction
Use credit spreads on the index with the 'scary' magnet for defined risk
